applies_why: The judge text resolves a challenge to a dropped limb as underdetermined rather than weighing a live pressed link, so it does not do the thing K-C governs.
quote: C4 pressed against the curse limb the defender dropped in [CR3] LINK 5, so no live link remains to contradict; the dropping is recorded there.
rule_words: When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.
room: pressed against a link: (1) a challenge to a dropped limb still counts as pressed against a link and triggers K-C; (2) a dropped limb is not a live link, so K-C does not trigger
why: The judge text says the defender dropped the very limb C4 pressed, so there is no live link to weigh and K-C does not require chain-against-chain treatment.
